text: Ko sabu goonga Men jippini ndee Alqur'aanaare e Muhammadu (yo Alla juulu e makko O hisina), ko Goonga jippii e mayre ko aldaa e wattitugol wonaa waylugol, Men nuliraali ma -ko an yo Nulaaɗo- si wonaa ko a wewliniroowo yimɓe hulooɓe Alla ɓen aljjanna, ko a hulɓiniroowo yimɓe keefeeru ngun e geddi ɗin yiite ngen.
